title: Keto Portuguese Passion Fruit Tart
description: A keto version of the traditional Portuguese tart, featuring a jammy passion fruit filling in a tandoor clay pot, this dessert is perfect for special occasions. The combination of passion fruit pulp and keto friendly ingredients creates a unique and delicious flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and salt in a bowl.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in the preheated tandoor clay pot.
Bake the crust for 20 minutes or until lightly golden.
Mix the passion fruit pulp with a little granulated sweetener and spoon it into the baked crust.
Return the tart to the tandoor clay pot and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool before serving.
